as_told.title: Dick Cheney as last head of the program

plain: Dick Cheney, the former US vice president, is said to have been the head of the government's secret UFO program, according to David Grusch, a former US intelligence officer who went public as a whistleblower about such programs. Michels repeats this twice on the show, once noting that Cheney had just died, and once putting it as a question to a guest, a Pentagon scientist named Davis, framing Cheney as the program's last top man, until 2009.
